fusions.name: Circle Up
fusions.desc: Circles the quarry in, dealing 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Snag Bites
fusions.desc: Snaps for 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 3 seconds, with a 30% chance of [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Catch Line
fusions.desc: Takes 1 second to set a snare at the nearest enemy. It waits up to 25 seconds, and the first enemy to come within 2 tiles takes 16 damage and is [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Drag the Catch
fusions.desc: Each time you inflict a condition, you regain 2 health a second for 4 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
